- Data residency: Redwood supports region-specific deployments and private VPC/private deployments so embeddings and inference can be kept in your cloud region. For hosted accounts we offer EU/US region pinning and additional controls (we can have Monica walk through the SOC2/KMS options on the call).

I'll include a one-page security snippet in the invite (attachment) and Monica is on the call to answer technical questions.

See you Wednesday —
